judgment_text:
Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a writ of mandamus to direct 1st respondent to conduct Election for the Highways Employees Co-operative House site Society bearing Regn. No. MDS/HSG/141(2nd Respondent Society)

ORDER

The relief sought for in the writ petition is for a Mandamus to direct the Registrar of cooperative society (Housing) to conduct election for the Highways Employees Cooperative House Site Society.

2. Mr K. Tamizhvendan, learned government advocate appearing for the respondents states that the elections were conducted and the period of election also expired on the year 2023. It is not an intention of the Government to hold the election of the Society in the near future.

3. Recording the same, this Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is dismissed. No costs.
